Selbständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

descriptionByLocale.en:
Service technician (m/f/d) Where do people love what they do and are great at it? At Swisslog, of course! Our teams are at the heart of a world-leading data- and robot-driven company that harnesses the power of technology to shape the future of intralogistics. The result? We deliver performance and efficiency to our customers around the world, giving them the decisive advantage in their markets. Job description Here you do something
• Maintenance and repair services of mechanical equipment
• Analysis and correction of malfunctions in intralogistics installations
• Writing of reports
• Takeover of planned and spontaneous assignments (incl. Picettdienst)
• Assignments at irregular working hours, including night and weekend work
• Support for our customers during multi-day assignments mainly within Switzerland and in Europe Applicant profile This is what you bring with you
• Completed mechanical training or equivalent qualification
• Professional experience as a service technician
• Very good skills in reading and interpreting drawings and layouts
• Knowledge of electrical engineering is advantageous
• Safe handling of the PC and common applications
• High commitment, flexibility and customer orientation
• Self-employed and reliable working methods
• Physically fit, healthy and vertigo-free
• Willingness to travel and openness to night and weekend work
• Valid Cat B ID
• Very good knowledge of German and good knowledge of English in words and writing, knowledge of French is advantageous Our Promise to You Swisslog is a world full of possibilities. With us, you shape the future of intralogistics with data- and robot-controlled automation solutions. This creates exceptional added value for our customers. Join us on this journey and become part of a global company proud of its Swiss roots. As a global company, we look forward to the opportunities offered to everyone in the Swisslog family. Unleash your potential in a team united by passion and driven by the OneSwisslog team spirit. About Swisslog Swisslog shapes the future of intralogistics. As part of the KUKA Group, we are working on the latest technologies that reinvent the world of logistics. We are a team of 3,000+ experts from 50 countries serving some of the biggest and most exciting brands in the world. Together, we implement smart and innovative approaches, including flexible data and robotic automation solutions that transform the supply chain. Complement our team and share your unique perspective. Go with us on the journey! If you think a career at Swisslog could be right for you, we would love to hear from you. We look forward to your application!
